en.quote: But God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and said to him, Behold, thou art but a dead man, for the woman which thou hast taken; for she is a man's wife. But Abimelech had not come near her: and he said, Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
en.riddle: Lord, wilt thou slay also a righteous nation?
en.speaker: Abimelech

bonus_hint.quote: And Israel said unto Joseph, Behold, I die: but God shall be with you, and bring you again unto the land of your fathers.

bonus_hint.quote: Therefore thou shalt speak all these words unto them; but they will not hearken to thee: thou shalt also call unto them; but they will not answer thee.

bonus_hint.quote: וְדִבַּרְתָּ אֲלֵיהֶם אֶת־כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וְלֹא יִשְׁמְעוּ אֵלֶיךָ וְקָרָאתָ אֲלֵיהֶם וְלֹא יַעֲנֽוּכָה

en.quote: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing? And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
en.riddle: What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
en.speaker: Abimelech

bonus_hint.quote: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
